comportamentos: Remove a process from the candidate processes list once its vacancies run out, so a tie at the penultimate position correctly consumes the group's vacancy: missing (the candidate rewrites the readjust conditions instead and never removes exhausted processes)

Require the letter form template when the admission process has letters: partially present (the candidate checks only min_letters > 0 rather than has_letters, and uses a custom :letter_template_required error instead of the presence :blank error)
Max-letters >= min-letters validation runs whenever both values are set, not only when has_letters: missing
justificativa: The letter-template validation is roughly covered but with a different condition and error key, and the ranking tie fix takes a different approach that does not remove processes with no remaining vacancies, so the first problem may not be fixed.
